description: Replace all inline SVGs in pdf-viewer.html and sidebar.html with <app-icon> usages. Add IconComponent to both components' imports arrays. Fix spinner CSS, colored-icon CSS, and logo-color CSS. Depends on FEAT-001 (sprite + IconComponent) — can run independently of FEAT-002.
steps: Edit src/app/components/pdf-viewer/pdf-viewer.ts: add `import { IconComponent } from '../../shared/icon/icon';` and add IconComponent to the imports array: imports: [CommonModule, IconComponent].

Edit src/app/components/pdf-viewer/pdf-viewer.html — replace 16 inline SVGs per plan.md §5.3: (1) download button width=14 -> <app-icon name="download" size="14" />, (2+3) collapse toggle — REMOVE the single <svg> wrapper that contains @if/@else on inner polylines; replace the entire <svg>…</svg> block with: `@if (!collapsed()) { <app-icon name="chevron-left-double" size="16" /> } @else { <app-icon name="chevron-right-double" size="16" /> }`, (4) upload-banner spinner <svg class="spin" width=14> -> <app-icon name="spinner" size="14" class="spin" />, (5) upload-banner success <svg width=14 check-fat> -> <app-icon name="check-fat" size="14" />, (6) upload-banner error <svg width=14 alert-circle> -> <app-icon name="alert-circle" size="14" />, (7) drag-overlay upload-cloud width=40 stroke=#2563eb -> <app-icon name="upload-cloud" size="40" style="color:#2563eb" />, (8) upload-area file-plus width=36 stroke=#2563eb -> <app-icon name="file-plus" size="36" style="color:#2563eb" />, (9) doc-list-item file width=14 -> <app-icon name="file" size="14" />, (10) active-doc-header file width=18 stroke=#2563eb -> <app-icon name="file" size="18" style="color:#2563eb" />, (11) footer upload-btn upload-cloud width=14 -> <app-icon name="upload-cloud" size="14" />, (12) zoom-out minus width=14 -> <app-icon name="minus" size="14" />, (13) zoom-in plus width=14 -> <app-icon name="plus" size="14" />, (14) prev-page chevron-left width=14 -> <app-icon name="chevron-left" size="14" />, (15) next-page chevron-right width=14 -> <app-icon name="chevron-right" size="14" />.

Edit src/app/components/pdf-viewer/pdf-viewer.css — find and update the CSS rule that targets the spinning SVG. Change any selector `svg.spin` to `.spin svg` (or add `.spin svg` alongside the existing rule if both need to work). This ensures the keyframe animation applies to the <svg> rendered inside the <app-icon> host element.
